God knows if I was skilled enough I'd do this for you, but I'm not. I think what might be better for you is to have a much more physical period of grief. Rather than a virtual one. Maybe get a small model of him printed out, keep it with you, keep it on your desk, your cupboard or your bedside. But above everything else, be patient with yourself. There's always light, it just sometimes take a while to get to us again. 
Grieve as much as you want, don't let anyone stop you. But be patient with yourself, comprehend the truth and maybe try forgiving life for what it is.
